Newer individual commentaries (Jerome, Eutropius, Pliny, Navigatio, Georgics, Agricola, Apuleius, Gesta Francorum) state CC BY-SA 3.0 in their preface and link https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/deed.en; the Core Vocabulary and Allen & Greenough pages state/badge CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported. Older commentaries (Caesar, Amores, Nepos, Sulpicius, Bede, the Cicero/Tacitus OBP re-editions) show no license on-page and fall under the site-wide statement. Treat all DCC content as CC BY-SA (3.0 or 4.0) — both allow redistribution with attribution and share-alike; cite the specific page you relied on. DCC asks (not requires) an email to dickinsoncommentaries@gmail.com describing reuse. DCC commentaries are HTML only (no PDFs); the print/PDF forms of Amores (OBP.0067), Nepos Hannibal (OBP.0068), Verres (OBP.0016), De Imperio (OBP.0045), Tacitus Annals (OBP.0035) and Philippic 2 (OBP.0156) live at Open Book Publishers. Audio pronunciation is not stated on DCC pages (recorded as 'desconhecida'); DCC recordings are generally restored classical pronunciation but this was not verified at the source.
OBP: licenses vary by volume and must be read per book: OBP.0016 Verres (2011) = CC BY-NC-ND 2.0 UK; OBP.0023 Aeneid 4 (2012) = CC BY-NC 3.0; OBP.0035 Tacitus (2013) = CC BY 3.0; OBP.0045, 0067, 0068, 0073, 0156, 0158 (2014-2018) = CC BY 4.0 (0068 recordings CC BY-SA 4.0). URL patterns: HTML edition https://books.openbookpublishers.com/10.11647/obp.NNNN/ ; PDF https://books.openbookpublishers.com/10.11647/obp.NNNN.pdf (returns HTTP 405 to curl's default User-Agent and to HEAD requests; returns 200 application/pdf with a browser User-Agent — any mirror/link checker must send a browser UA); DOI https://doi.org/10.11647/OBP.NNNN (302 to www.openbookpublishers.com/books/10.11647/obp.NNNN). www.openbookpublishers.com answered HTTP 429 (rate-limited) for the entire session, so the publisher landing pages were NOT read directly; license statements were read from the books.openbookpublishers.com copyright pages (HTML) and, for 0016/0023, from the PDF copyright page via pdftotext. OBP also mirrors PDFs on OAPEN, Internet Archive and Zenodo (listed on Thoth records) but those mirror URLs were not individually HEAD-checked. Ancient author death years are given as negative integers for BCE.
